faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does residential interior design in Hauz Khas include?

Room planning, kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms, false ceilings, lighting, flooring, furniture and décor for builder floors, apartments and independent houses.

How do you add storage in compact homes?

Full-height wardrobes, storage beds, built-in seating and smart kitchen units add storage without crowding the rooms.

Can you design a home for a joint family?

Yes. We plan private areas for each generation and shared spaces for the family, with storage and furniture suited to different needs.

When should residential interior design begin?

Ideally before civil work starts, so electrical, plumbing and furniture plans are fixed early and nothing needs to be broken later.
